p.i: mino, quòd elegantioribus & cultioribus ingenijs ali-qua ex parte præluxero, ut inuestigent commodio-rem obscurorum locorum & quæstionum quarum-dam interpretationem. Etsi omnia quæcunque à me sunt, libentissimè atque ex animo subjicio autoritati judicioq; Ecclesiæ & tuo. Vale in Domino feli-citer, observandæ frater & coniunctissime, atque his meis cogitationibus, fra-terno, ut soles, animo utere.

page.notes: The first line of the page is cut at the top edge and begins as a fragment ("mino"). The signature mark "3" at upper left is a stray mark and was not transcribed. The word "præluxero" and "judicioq;" were read with care; the small superscript mark after "judicioq" is a reference-like sign and was not separately transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is present in the lower half and was omitted.
